title: 第11章 狠棋
slug: 官榜全本免费-官榜最新章节列表
content_zh:
说到这高萍,在邢唐县还真算的上是个人物,人长的很俊俏,盘子不错,即便四十岁保养的却很好,看上去就像是三十出头的样子。最为关键的是,她天生一副媚相,那种让人瞧了便感觉很为风骚的样子,最为容易点燃男人的欲望。
但就算高萍再风骚,在这邢唐县城却没有一个人敢对她垂涎。原因很简单,据说她是谢文的情人。
高萍的上位便是靠着出卖色相,卖弄床上功夫才一跃成为教育局局长。不然的话,几年之前还只是一个中学教师的她,怎么能够这么快上位?
当然这些风言风语只能在外面说说,没有谁敢当着谢文的面提起半句。就算在高萍面前,都没有谁会自讨没趣。没办法,谁让人家的靠山是县委书记,真要是惹急了人家,随便吹吹枕头风,便够自己喝一壶的。
而就像是传言的那样,即便现在这场合应该很为严肃,但高萍仍然穿着肉色丝袜,一系浅灰色的连衣裙,将那诱人的身段展现的淋漓尽致。
整个礼堂十几个老爷们,瞧着缓缓走上主席台的高萍,眼前都忍不住一亮。然而仅仅只能在心底狠狠的意·淫下,随即便抬头露出很为肃穆的神情,恭敬的等待着高萍布置教育局的任务。
高萍坐下后,很为满意的扫过全场,眼光在苏沐身上停留了一下,嘴角露出一抹神秘的笑容,很快便轻轻划过。
这个女人不简单!苏沐脑中想着,耳边已经响起高萍清脆的声音。
“同志们,今天在这里召开邢唐县教育工作扩大会议,是因为有件迫在眉睫的大事要向你们宣布。当然这件事也要征求一下你们的意见,毕竟你们都是各个乡镇负责科教文卫的一把手。”
高萍能够坐上教育局局长的宝座,显然不是一个没有头脑只有大胸的女人。先说要对你们宣布一件事,那便是定下了调子,不管今天这会议开成什么样,这件事是决定下来的,你们只要执行就是。
但紧接着又冒出一把手这样的话,分明就是暗中夸赞这些个副镇长,说你们劳苦功高。这是很为典型却又很为实用的一招,打一巴掌给个甜枣。
果然随着高萍这几句话的说出,下面这些副镇长的脸色顿时变的好看起来,其中有些仗着资格老的,已经开始说起来。
“高局长,说吧,什么事这么重要?”
“是啊,瞧高局长的样子,肯定是好事吧!”
“有高局长在前面给咱们把关,你说什么就是什么!”
高萍微笑着扫过去,将这些恭维的话全都收下,随即说道:“你们还真的猜对了,这件事还真算是好事。同志们,你们都是奋战在教育工作第一战线的一把手,应该比别人更加知道,百年大计,教育为本。
一个国家如果没有教育事业,那么这个国家离衰败灭亡也就不远。再穷再苦咱们都不能放弃教育,这是最基本的原则问题。因为这个原因,前几天县委县政府召开了几次会议,最终决定,在邢唐县十五个乡镇中进行一次教育大变革。”
说到这里高萍略微停顿了下,将每个人的神情收在眼底,弯起嘴角笑着道:“这个教育大变革便是,县委县政府决定对全县下属的乡镇小学进行一次彻底的整顿。不管是哪个乡镇,不管涉及到哪个小学,只要是危房一律拆除重修,我们要从硬件设施上,保证每个学生的学习环境。”
邢唐县全县小学危房改造?
高萍宣布的这个决定,当场便让小礼堂所有人愣住。这是什么意思?要知道邢唐县的那些个小学,去年才有过一次改造,怎么今年又要弄吗?

没错,去年改造的时候,那些个经济条件比较好的乡镇是重新建了新学校,经济条件不好的乡镇只是进行了维修。但这也算是应付过去去年的任务了,怎么短短一年不到的时间,又要开始危房改造?
难不成县委县政府的那些个人吃饱撑了没事干吗?
显然不是这个答案!
能在官场混着的人,没有谁是傻子,就算再不行的人,在官场这个大染缸混上了几年,也会变成老油条子,聪明奸诈的很。
这便是天朝独特的官场文化!
高萍话音刚落,眼神便飘向苏沐那边,这些个老狐狸哪里还能不明白这是怎么回事?这分明就是针对黑山镇,针对苏沐的吗?

content_en:
Speaking of Gao Ping, he is really a figure in Xingtang County. He is very handsome and has a good plate. Even though he is forty years old, he is well maintained and looks like he is in his early thirties. The most important thing is that she has a naturally charming look, which makes people feel very coquettish just by looking at her, which is the easiest way to ignite men's desire.
But no matter how coquettish Gao Ping is, no one in Xingtang County dares to covet her. The reason is very simple, it is said that she is Xie Wen's lover.
Gao Ping rose to the top by selling her looks and her skills in bed to become the director of the Education Bureau. Otherwise, how could she, who was just a middle school teacher a few years ago, rise to the top so quickly?
Of course, these rumors can only be talked about outside, no one dares to mention a word in front of Xie Wen. Even in front of Gao Ping, no one would ask for trouble. There is no other way. If someone's backer is the secretary of the county party committee, if they really make them anxious, just blowing on the pillow will be enough to drink a pot of water.
And just like the rumors, even though the occasion should be very serious now, Gao Ping still wore flesh-colored stockings and a light gray dress, showing off her seductive figure to the fullest.
The dozen or so gentlemen in the entire auditorium couldn't help but light up when they saw Gao Ping slowly walking up to the podium. However, with the fierce desire in his heart, he immediately raised his head with a very solemn expression, respectfully waiting for Gao Ping to assign the tasks of the Education Bureau.
After Gao Ping sat down, she scanned the whole place with great satisfaction. Her eyes paused on Su Mu for a moment, and a mysterious smile appeared on the corner of her mouth, which soon passed lightly.
This woman is not simple! Su Mu thought, Gao Ping's clear voice sounded in her ears.
"Comrades, the expanded meeting on education work in Xingtang County is held here today because there is an imminent major event that I want to announce to you. Of course, your opinions must be sought on this matter. After all, you are the leaders in charge of science, education, culture and health in each township."
Gao Ping is able to sit on the throne of the Director of the Education Bureau. She is obviously not a woman with no brains and only big breasts. First, I want to announce something to you, and that is that the tone has been set. No matter how the meeting goes today, this matter has been decided, and you just have to implement it.
But then another leader said something like this, clearly praising these deputy mayors secretly, saying that you have worked hard and achieved great results. This is a very typical but very practical move, giving a sweet date with a slap.
Sure enough, as Gao Ping said these words, the faces of the deputy mayors below suddenly became better, and some of them started to talk based on their seniority.
"Director Gao, tell me, what is so important?"
"Yes, looking at Director Gao's appearance, it must be a good thing!"
"With Director Gao checking us out from the front, whatever you say will be yours!"
Gao Ping glanced over with a smile, accepted all these compliments, and then said: "You really guessed it right, this is really a good thing. Comrades, you are all leaders fighting on the front line of education, and you should know better than others that education is the foundation of a century-old plan.
If a country does not have education, then the country is not far from decline and destruction. No matter how poor or miserable we are, we cannot give up education. This is the most basic matter of principle. For this reason, the county committee and county government held several meetings a few days ago and finally decided to carry out a major education reform in the fifteen towns and villages of Xingtang County. "
At this point, Gao Ping paused for a moment, looked at everyone's expressions, and said with a smile: "This big change in education is that the county party committee and county government decided to conduct a thorough rectification of the township primary schools under the county. No matter which township, no matter which primary school is involved, as long as the dilapidated buildings are demolished and rebuilt, we must ensure the learning environment for every student in terms of hardware facilities."
XingRenovation of dilapidated buildings in all primary schools in Tang County?
The decision announced by Gao Ping stunned everyone in the small auditorium on the spot. What does this mean? You know, the primary schools in Xingtang County were renovated last year. Why are they being renovated again this year?
That's right, during last year's renovation, those towns with relatively good economic conditions built new schools, while those with poor economic conditions only carried out repairs. But this can be regarded as the task of coping with the past year. Why is it that in less than a year, the renovation of dilapidated buildings has to start again?
Is it possible that those individuals in the county committee and county government have nothing to do when they are full?
Obviously not the answer!
No one who can get along in the officialdom is a fool. No matter how incompetent he is, after a few years of being in the officialdom, he will become a very clever and cunning person.
This is the unique official culture of China!
As soon as Gao Ping finished speaking, her eyes drifted towards Su Mu. How could these old foxes not understand what was going on? Is this clearly aimed at Black Mountain Town and Su Mu?
